annotations.text:
The profile IS your dubplate.

The app already draws records — grooves over vinyl, a gold centre label, a spindle. Your initial goes on the label, and the page is what is pressed into it.

Four parts now: who you are, the ledger, what you have called, and the one setting that lives here. Pins went (home is already that shelf) and the keeper shelf went with them — the ledger's "Držáků" carries that idea without spending half a screen on it.

Language is a SELECT, not pills: the list will grow, and a row of pills stops being a row at five languages.

The submit beside it is what keeps it working with no JS. Nothing else in this app is JS-only and this must not be the first thing that is.

The same page with one vote and no instruments yet — the state you are actually in today.

With the shelf gone this is now a short, honest page rather than a long one padded with outlines. Agreement still reads "—" rather than a dishonest 0%.
Sign out rides the PLATE's line — beside the name it was a chip stranded in dead space. Ledger goes 2×2 so no figure shrinks.
